thread:
Maria: Heads-up - Valencia Health wants a short POC. Key asks: SAML SSO, SCIM user+group sync (AD), RBAC mapping to AD groups, domain proof for multiple subdomains, audit log retention, and KMS options. They also attached a security questionnaire. Need a concise response for their InfoSec.

Priya: Got it. Do we have a recommended SCIM attribute map for AD? they mentioned employeeNumber -> external_id and dept -> group.

Alex: Yes. We usually map `employeeNumber` -> `externalId` and use the SCIM `groups` array for RBAC. Example payload we send for onboarding (idempotent upsert): `{\"userName\":\"j.ramirez@valencia.health\",\"externalId\":\"12345\",\"name\":{\"givenName\":\"Jose\",\"familyName\":\"Ramirez\"},\"emails\":[{\"value\":\"j.ramirez@valencia.health\",\"primary\":true}],\"groups\":[{\"value\":\"ops\",\"display\":\"Ops\"}]}`.

Sam: SCIM supports PATCH (recommended) and full replace. For the POC suggest PATCH so we sync deltas. We can enable throttling and surface sync metrics in the Console.

Jordan: Security items: we can provide SOC2 report. Hosted uses platform-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK/HSM). Audit logs stored in our logging service; export in JSON/CSV and retention configurable up to enterprise tiers (default 365d). Domain proofing requires TXT DNS or file verification; MX-only isn't acceptable for proving ownership.

Casey: RBAC mapping is configurable in Console > Settings > Identity. For the POC we can pre-create roles (viewer/editor/admin) and map AD groups. Precedence rules are documented.

Luis: Pricing question: SCIM is included for enterprise plans. Dedicated (reserved capacity) is a different SKU with monthly commit. For Valencia we should offer two POC flavors: Hosted 30d usage-based or Dedicated trial 30d with discounted commit if they need isolation/KMS.

Priya: I'll draft two proposal lines and flag extra charges for extended audit retention beyond 365 days and for extended SLAs.

Maria: Valencia attached the questionnaire: https://redwood.box/valencia-security-questionnaire.xlsx. They also want an on-call contact and escalation path.

Jordan: I'll own the security questionnaire. For SCIM rate limits: default 120 reqs/min per customer on Hosted; negotiable on Dedicated. Retry behavior: exponential backoff with jitter.

Alex: For SAML we support standard SP metadata. Ask them for IdP metadata or an Okta test org. NameID should be email or persistent; common gotcha is NameID format mismatch and clock skew. Provide the SP metadata once they send the IdP metadata. Also need 5 test users: 1 admin, 2 editors, 2 viewers and a CSV of groups.

Sam: I'll draft a short ops runbook covering SCIM sync troubleshooting, SAML test checklist, role mapping verification, and common errors (NameID, certificate rotation). ETA 24h.

Casey: Proposed POC timeline: Week0 exchange metadata + test accounts; Week1 SAML auth + SCIM validation; Week2 role mapping + audit export; Week3 demo + close. If they choose Dedicated trial we may need extra provisioning lead time.

Maria: Action items: Maria - collect IdP metadata/CSV + upload questionnaire (done). Alex - SP metadata + SCIM template (ETA 24h). Sam - ops runbook (ETA 24h). Jordan - security Q (ETA 48h). Casey/Priya - pricing options + KMS differences (ETA 48h). Priya - draft outbound to Valencia for review.

Priya: I'll post the draft in #sales-drafts. Should we mention HIPAA/BAA proactively since they're healthcare?

Jordan: Yes call out HIPAA and BAA needs. If they require a BAA we escalate to legal; Private/Dedicated preferred for PHI.

Luis: Note on domain proofing: we support wildcard verification for subdomains with TXT at root; delegated domains across tenants require a different flow.

Alex: Uploaded SP metadata & SCIM example: https://redwood.box/valencia-sp-scim.zip

Sam: Ops runbook draft here: https://redwood.box/valencia-ops-runbook.md — please review.

Maria: I'll consolidate and send to Valencia tomorrow AM. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
